workflows.title: Wearable-assisted fitness and activity support
workflows.why: Use user-approved wearable evidence as optional input to routines, accountability, activity trends, and goal review without inferring diagnosis or changing goals automatically.
workflows.prompt: I can use data from {integrations} to help with your {goal}. Nothing changes automatically. Do you want help setting that up?

workflows.title: Financial activity and spending support
workflows.why: Use a verified read-only financial connection to reconcile spending, charges, subscriptions, and user-selected financial goals. Purchases, transfers, card payments, refunds and reimbursements remain distinct economic events so money is not counted twice.
workflows.prompt: I can use your connected {integrations} data to help with {goal}. Nothing changes automatically. Do you want help setting that up?

workflows.title: Email evidence for orders, receipts, appointments, and admin
workflows.why: Use approved mailbox read access as evidence while preserving canonical state outside email and never sending mail automatically. Appointment senders are correlated to the durable provider/entity directory before repeated public research.
workflows.prompt: Your connected {integrations} can reduce manual entry for {goal}. Nothing will be sent automatically. Do you want help using it for that?

workflows.title: Calendar-aware appointments and reminder projection
workflows.why: Use calendar evidence for awareness and, only when write/readback is verified, project user-approved reminders without creating one automation per event.
workflows.prompt: I can use {integrations} to help with {goal}. If reminder write access is available, I can also verify projections. Do you want help setting that up?

workflows.title: Spoken appointment reminders on a verified device
workflows.why: A supported notification integration may also expose a device-specific spoken-notification sub-capability. MIRA tests that sub-capability before enabling Text-to-Speech delivery; ordinary visual notification capability alone is not claimed to prove audio delivery.
workflows.prompt: Your connected {integrations} may support spoken appointment reminders for {goal}. Nothing changes automatically. Do you want help testing whether spoken delivery actually works on your device?

workflows.title: Document and evidence archive
workflows.why: Retain receipts, manuals, documents, and provenance in a verified evidence store. The workflow targets the evidence capability rather than a particular Drive/object-storage provider.
workflows.prompt: I can use {integrations} as the document store for {goal}. Nothing will be moved or created until you approve the workflow. Do you want help setting that up?

workflows.title: Location-aware travel and mileage support
workflows.why: Use approved location evidence only for user-selected route, travel, context, or mileage workflows and never as an undeclared background tracker.
workflows.prompt: I can use {integrations} to reduce manual updates for {goal}. Do you want help setting that up?

workflows.title: Home Assistant context and household workflows
workflows.why: Use explicitly approved Home Assistant state as an optional evidence source for household workflows without assuming cloud reachability or write authority.
workflows.prompt: I can use {integrations} as optional evidence for {goal}. Do you want help designing a workflow around it?

workflows.title: Barcode and QR assisted asset intake
workflows.why: Decode identifiers locally when possible, then corroborate product/model identity, retrieve authoritative manuals, and link evidence to immutable asset/location UUIDs. Preprinted tags can be bound to assets or storage locations.
workflows.prompt: I can use barcode or QR scanning to speed up {goal}. Do you want help setting up product identification, asset/location labels, manual lookup, and database population?

workflows.title: Versioned custom workflow development
workflows.why: Use an approved Git provider for durable policy, tests, and custom features while keeping mutable personal state out of source control.
workflows.prompt: Your connected {integrations} can support versioned custom workflows for {goal}. Do you want help designing one?

workflows.title: Self-hosted M.I.R.R.O.R. runtime
workflows.why: Move the same provider-neutral behavior contracts behind an authenticated service/API with SQL/object-storage adapters. Local-model inference is an optional separate runtime capability, not a prerequisite for self-hosting.
workflows.prompt: Your connected {integrations} can support a more self-hosted setup for {goal}. Do you want help planning the migration without changing your current workflows yet?
